public_rationale: AGI Society stated on September 14, 2026 that there was no generally accepted empirical test for AGI [e2]. ARC Prize reported on September 3 that GPT-6 Astra surpassed the tested human baseline in action efficiency on ARC-AGI-3 [e3]. That result establishes a benchmark achievement, but cannot settle the AGI component without a specified success threshold [e2] [e3]. The combined claim therefore cannot be adjudicated from these findings [e2] [e3].
limitations: The claim supplies no operational AGI success threshold. Selecting one would add a material evaluator assumption.
The packet lacks records establishing the original eight-building Abilene campus's completion status on September 8, 2026.
The evidence establishes neither that AGI had been reached nor that it had not.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: AGI has not been reached, despite claims by NVIDIA and Crusoe, and Stargate Abilene has not been completed.

statement.excerpt: Neither NVIDIA nor Crusoe have actually done anything — we have not reached “AGI,” nor has “the birthplace of AGI” been completed, nor does anybody seem to bring up these facts in any of the pieces I’ve read outside of saying “hmm, well AGI isn’t really well-defined,” humouring what these companies are saying without a single thought entering their minds.

from_speaker: nor has “the birthplace of AGI” been completed
our_interpretation: The submitted claim combines an AGI judgment with a claim about completion of the original eight-building Abilene campus.
The supplied context describes AGI as handling tasks beyond original training, but gives no required breadth, reliability or performance threshold.
A benchmark chosen by the evaluator would determine the AGI verdict. Campus completion alone cannot settle the combined claim.
criteria.support_condition: For a scoreable combined claim, evidence would need to establish both that systems fell short of a specified AGI threshold and that the campus remained incomplete on September 8.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A verified AGI achievement under an agreed threshold, or records establishing full campus completion by September 8, would contradict the corresponding component.
